news.headline: Gaza ceasefire talks extend as mediators seek final deal
news.body: Mediators said negotiations to implement a U.S.-backed ceasefire between Israel and Hamas stalled over withdrawal and hostage‑release arrangements. Talks could continue into Sunday as envoys worked to close remaining gaps ahead of a possible agreement.
